saw_lines: Tea buyers pick a blend for one health goal, then reorder the same box for months without thinking.
So the first order is won or lost on whether the ad answers shipping and the subscription before the click.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it or any offer. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers subscribe and save, but 0 of 29 ads mention it or any offer. New buyers see no reason to act today. Put subscribe and save in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. A new buyer who cannot tell when the tea arrives scrolls past. Lead your new buyer ads with the free shipping above Rs 50.

The site has subscribe and save, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Reorders are where this tea earns its keep, but nobody is asked to lock one in. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline.
4 of 29 ads use claim words such as clinically, cure and guaranteed results. Those lines limit reach, and a buyer skeptical of cures scrolls past. Say what customers noticed in week one instead.
